name: immich
description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution.
one_liner: Your own private Google Photos: back up every phone photo to a server you control, with search and face grouping.
buyer: Photographers and families with huge libraries who are tired of rising cloud-storage bills and want to own their archive.
business_use_cases: A wedding photographer gives each couple a private, branded gallery that stays online for years without a per-photo cloud fee.
A real-estate agency keeps every property shoot organized and searchable by address for the whole team.
A family historian digitizes decades of prints into one searchable, face-tagged archive.

money_ideas.idea: Managed hosting: 'your own photo cloud, we run the server' for a flat monthly fee per family.
A setup-and-migrate service that moves people off Google Photos for a one-time fee.

steal_this: Offer local photographers a white-label client-gallery service on top of this, priced per wedding, instead of them paying big per-gallery SaaS fees.
